title: Tiny, cute glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- left lens -->
    <circle cx="36" cy="50" r="15" fill="#9fe8ff"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="50" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#2fd6ff" stroke-width="4"/>
    <!-- right lens -->
    <circle cx="64" cy="50" r="15" fill="#9fe8ff"/>
    <circle cx="64" cy="50" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#2fd6ff" stroke-width="4"/>
    <!-- bridge -->
    <rect x="49" y="47" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#2fd6ff"/>
    <!-- temples -->
    <rect x="16" y="46" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#2fd6ff"/>
    <rect x="78" y="46" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#2fd6ff"/>
    <!-- shine -->
    <circle cx="31" cy="44" r="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="44" r="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- cute blush cheeks peeking below -->
    <circle cx="30" cy="68" r="3" fill="#ff8fc7" opacity="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="68" r="3" fill="#ff8fc7" opacity="0.8"/>
  </g>
</svg>
